summary: Completed comprehensive Phase 4 production readiness testing of 10 Million Mistakes app. All new Settings/Profile page features working excellently: edit name, change password, retake quiz, delete account, logout. Backend APIs showing 97.1% success rate (68/70 tests passed). Admin dashboard with enhanced search/filter capabilities fully functional. Security hardening features (rate limiting, input validation, DB indexes) implemented and working. Error boundary protecting the app. Frontend UI flows working well with all Phase 4 features accessible and functional.
